# discord_server_onboarding (Resource)

Manages Discord server onboarding configuration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (Number) Onboarding mode (0 = default, 1 = advanced).
- `server_id` (String) The server (guild) ID.

### Optional

- `default_channel_ids` (List of String) Channel IDs that members get opted into automatically.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether onboarding is enabled.
- `prompts` (Block List) Prompts shown during onboarding. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--prompts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID (same as server_id).

<a id="nestedblock--prompts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prompts`

Required:

- `title` (String) Title of the prompt.

Optional:

- `in_onboarding` (Boolean) Whether the prompt is shown in the onboarding flow.
- `options` (Block List) Options within the prompt. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--prompts--options))
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the prompt is required before completing onboarding.
- `single_select` (Boolean) Whether users are limited to selecting one option.

<a id="nestedblock--prompts--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prompts.options`

Required:

- `title` (String) Title of the option.

Optional:

- `channel_ids` (List of String) Channel IDs a member is added to when the option is selected.
- `description` (String) Description of the option.
- `emoji_name` (String) Name of the emoji for this option (Unicode or custom emoji name).
- `role_ids` (List of String) Role IDs assigned to a member when the option is selected.
